name: Caro-Kann Advance — Tactics
description: Tactical motifs in the Caro-Kann Advance Variation.

drills.name: Challenging the Pawn Chain
drills.description: Black to move. Find the thematic way to pressure White's advanced center and develop the kingside.
drills.briefExplanation: Undermining the base with cxd4, then developing the knight to f5 via e7, is a thematic way to pressure d4.
